Name: Joab, Son of Seraiah
Summary: Son of Seraiah, called the father of the valley of Charashim, whose people were craftsmen.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:14: Son of Seraiah, called the father of the valley of Charashim, whose people were craftsmen.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Joab stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
